policy.priority_rule: High after at least 3 distinct accounts report the same blocking issue in a rolling 7-day window. Repeated calls do not count as new accounts. Urgent is never automatic in this demo.
policy.review_rule: Tentative commercial numbers and delivery commitments require human review. Approved values retain the source uncertainty in their history.
